_comment: OpticOdds mapping per the brief. Each record holds a nested `odds` object: moneyline/spread use home_odds / away_odds, totals use over / under (via market_overrides). Each price may be a decimal number, an odds object ({"decimal": 1.91}) or an ARRAY of such objects carrying their own "points" (alternate lines; the entry with is_main=true, else the first, is the main line). `updated_at` (record- or entry-level) drives the 30s freshness rule. Record paths and the URL are ASSUMED - verify against a real response from your OpticOdds account. Copy to sharp_provider.json and export SHARP_API_KEY.
